title: Physical stackup composed from the approved jlcpcb catalog
provenance: jlcpcb approved catalog 953f02eab19f, source capabilities, retrieved 2026-08-25, stackup Composed 2L 1.6 mm 1 oz (composed from stated values, not a published construction)
notes: Every value here restates the approved fabricator catalog entry named in `provenance`; none is measured from a board and none is a general-knowledge default.

This construction is composed, not published: the fabricator publishes no two-layer construction; a two-layer board is one copper-clad laminate, so its stack follows from stated values with no unpublished choice remaining. Its dielectric thickness is the stated finished thickness less both stated copper foils.
